hero.title: What does this look like for others?
hero.intro: What was missing before, what I built, and what my clients say about it. You can see every site live.

projects.title: Allmacher Coaching: website for a negotiation seminar
projects.problem: A strong seminar, but no place that quickly shows leaders why it is worth their time.
projects.solution: A seminar site that walks through content, trainer, and tickets in a clear order and leads straight to the inquiry.
projects.result: The seminar is easy to grasp at a glance, with Dr. Allmacher front and centre as the trainer.

shots.label: Start
shots.caption: The entry point: topic, value, and inquiry at a glance.
shots.alt: Top section of the Allmacher Coaching website with seminar title, short description, and inquiry button

shots.label: Difference
shots.caption: Side-by-side contrasts show what makes this seminar different.
shots.alt: Section “Besonderheit” with contrasts such as “taking part instead of listening” around a seminar photo

shots.label: Trainer
shots.caption: Dr. Christoph Allmacher as the face and trust anchor of the seminar.
shots.alt: Section about seminar leader Dr. Christoph Allmacher with portrait and short introduction

scope: seminar offer split into clear sections
trainer and method made visible as trust anchors
consistent guidance toward the seminar inquiry

projects.title: Financial broker website with clear positioning
projects.problem: Finance quickly feels complicated, and prospects need trust before they reach out.
projects.solution: A calm presence that addresses common worries, orders the services clearly, and leads to a first call.
projects.result: The site feels trustworthy, gives quick orientation, and makes the inquiry the obvious next step.

shots.label: Start
shots.caption: The entry point: advice without sales pressure as a clear promise.
shots.alt: Top section of Kolja Wienigk's financial broker website with headline and button for a first call

shots.label: Worries
shots.caption: Common worries of prospects are addressed openly.
shots.alt: Section “Das höre ich am häufigsten” with three client quotes

shots.label: Services
shots.caption: Advisory areas in an understandable order instead of a product list.
shots.alt: Section with the advisory areas financial management and real estate shown as cards

projects.title: Consumption trial for structured usage data capture
projects.problem: Usage data took effort to capture and was hard to read during the ongoing process.
projects.solution: A lean tool that simplifies inputs and keeps the status visible at all times.
projects.result: Less manual effort and usage data that is faster to evaluate.

shots.label: Capture
shots.caption: The mobile overview: every entry with date, amount, and location.
shots.alt: Mobile view of the Consumption Trial with recorded charging sessions

scope: compact input logic with less friction
clear interface for technical consumption data
better readability across the active workflow

closingCta.title: If your next project needs the same level of clarity, the next step stays short.
closingCta.supportingText: Whether it is a new website, a relaunch, or an internal tool, the strongest leverage comes from clear guidance before the first build, not louder visuals.
